cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/positions && date -u; systemctl is-active chan-orders classicbot pos-tracker; echo --- LOG; tail -25 chan.log | cut -c1-220; echo --- COUNTS; grep -c SKIP chan.log; python3 -c "
import json,collections,datetime
E=json.load(open('chan_events.json'));O=json.load(open('orders.json'));P=json.load(open('positions.json'))
print('events',collections.Counter(e['status'] for e in E))
print('last 8 events',[(e['sym'],e['dir'],e['status'],(e.get('reason') or '')[:30]) for e in E[-8:]])
print('orders pending',[o['sym'] for o in O if o['status']=='pending'],'open pos',[p['sym'] for p in P if p['status']=='open'])
print('last order t',datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(O[-1]['placed_t']/1000))
"
